verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents programmatic control of browser sessions, a Downloads API, and explicit UI/SDK parity for webhook endpoint management. However, agent creation is documented through the dashboard and the Optimize tool lives in the dashboard run view, with no API equivalent shown, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API parity for agent creation and the Optimize tool, a published OpenAPI spec, and any explicit statement of full UI/API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can manage endpoints from Settings as well as through the SDK. Both act on the same webhooks.
Create, control, and observe browser sessions programmatically.
Retrieve it with the Downloads API using the sessionId from the run.
